metadata.scope: Same main projections/RMSNorm/paged cache as experiments 1-3. Full indexer and selection included. Two-stage additionally updates cached block means, scores blocks, selects candidate blocks, scores their tokens, selects final tokens, and converts indices. Cache initialization/planning/JIT/capture excluded.
metadata.two_stage: Mean-pooled 128-token keys; 64 candidate blocks by default; force current block; exact top-2048 within candidates. Approximate relative to global token top-k.
metadata.timing: Final prefill chunk 2048 total tokens eager; decode one token/request CUDA graph; L2 flush outside timing; >=3 warmups.
